title: Work Space — desk / office hygiene stack
summary: Permanent daytime desk stack: office breakers, grounding mat, negative ions, and low artificial field—a combined daytime routine with no fixed clock time.

sections.heading: Why Work Space
sections.body: Most nnEMF and dirty-electricity exposure for desk workers happens in the workday environment. Rolling breakers-when-unused, grounding, optional ions, and low-field desk habits into one repeatable practice mirrors Sleep Space without forcing a morning-only practice. Use only what fits your space and safety needs.

sections.heading: How the routine fits together
sections.body: This routine combines several practical choices: powering down unused office circuits, using a verified grounding mat, optional negative ions, and lowering unnecessary artificial-field exposure. Use the parts that fit your space and safety needs. Air-tube headphones remain a separate permanent for call hygiene.

sections.heading: What each option means in practice
sections.body: Breakers off: work circuits powered down when the room is unused (safe labeling first). Grounding mat: desk or floor mat on a verified Earth reference—prefer an exterior stake over blind outlet ground. Negative ions: ionizer during work hours in a ventilated spot, cleaned per maker guidance. Low artificial field: phone off lap, router distance or airplane mode when practical, chargers not coiled on the torso—intentional desk hygiene, not perfection every minute.

sections.heading: Where Dr. Jack Kruse’s teaching is specific
sections.body: Kruse extends nnEMF discipline into the workday: long hours next to radios, dirty wiring, and metal-dense desks are framed as load on the same mitochondrial story as the bedroom. Work Space is the guide’s combined view for that daytime half. Brand-level desk prescriptions in forums are culture; distance and power-down are the durable habits.

sections.heading: What is solid, what is framework
sections.body: Solid ground: distance from transmitters, killing unused loads, and safer grounding references are engineering hygiene. Framework: that a desk ionizer or mat by itself demonstrates clinical recovery. Pair Work Space with Sleep Space for a full indoor loop—not as medical treatment.

sections.heading: How to use it here
sections.body: For a desk routine, start with the electrical and grounding practices that fit your space. Pair lower-field work habits with sleep hygiene and air-tube headphones for calls. Use airplane mode away from the desk when practical. Educational only.
